purpose: Developer handoff checklist for turning the prototype showroom into an official project showroom.

url_rules.empty_slot_behavior: Hide the control or show material pending; never render a broken button.
url_rules.cost_control: Mapbox/Cesium/3D Tiles must stay lazy and user-opened.

official_materials.label: Official BIM / optimized GLB
official_materials.public_policy: Keep illustrative label until developer-approved model replaces the prototype.

official_materials.label: Official model poster / still frame
official_materials.public_policy: Use as loading poster only; optimize before upload.

official_materials.label: Project sales video
official_materials.public_policy: Use only owner/developer-approved video. Do not scrape or copy embedded video.

official_materials.label: Interior or apartment virtual tour
official_materials.public_policy: Use only approved tours. Do not generate fake interiors for public unit claims.

official_materials.label: Cesium / 3D Tiles city-view layer
official_materials.public_policy: Lazy-load only after user opens the view layer and cost governance is approved.

official_materials.label: Approved elevation, site plan and floor plans
official_materials.public_policy: Prototype drawings must keep illustrative labels until official sale plans arrive.

official_materials.label: Unit inventory and availability feed
official_materials.public_policy: Do not show real prices or availability until source/license and owner approval are recorded.

official_materials.label: Per-unit interior media
official_materials.public_policy: Leave empty unless the interior belongs to that unit/type and is approved for public use.

official_materials.label: Per-unit tour links
official_materials.public_policy: Leave empty unless the tour is official or owner-approved.

official_materials.label: Nearby projects, parks, schools, transport and public services
official_materials.public_policy: Use precise pins only when verified. Planned facilities need planned/future labels.

zillow_parity_map.view_layer: Mapbox now, Cesium/3D Tiles seam when approved
zillow_parity_map.price_context: project_3d_avg_price_per_sqm + project_3d_price_source_note or approved unit price
zillow_parity_map.lead_capture: existing lead funnel with selected unit payload

owner_questions_before_official_launch: Which developer/project materials are approved for public use?
Can project video/tour URLs be embedded publicly?
Which unit rows are live inventory and which are examples?
May approximate price context be shown, and from which source?
Which surroundings pins have verified coordinates?
